goal:
In kestrel-team (Python; gate `uv run --locked python -m pytest tests/ -q`,
fully mocked, no network; base = main after queue/0076 merges), make
`cloud audit`'s containment check stop failing on ref changes the audit can
account for. READ CLAUDE.md FIRST. Nothing else changes (0025 decision 2).

Facts (kestrel-helm queue/0072 and 0075 Records, 2026-10-29).
`check_containment` in `core/cloud_audit.py` diffs the remote's refs now
against `refs_before` (taken by prepare right after the task push) and FAILs
on any added, deleted or moved ref other than the work branch. Two items
fired on the same repo 38 s apart: each audit FAILed on the other's
`task/<id>` and `cloud/<id>` branches, while the work itself was good (0072:
host_gate PASS 1245, mutation PASS). The same check also FAILs when the
operator opens a PR (`refs/pull/<n>/head` added) or merges anything
(`refs/heads/main` moved) between prepare and audit.

Change the check so a ref change is **accounted for**, listed in
`details["refs_accounted"]` with its reason, and not a FAIL, when it is one of:
(a) an added or moved ref under `OTHER_RUN_PREFIXES = ("refs/heads/task/",
"refs/heads/cloud/")` whose suffix names another item that has a
`prepared.json` under the same state root's `cloud-runs/` (another prepared
run's branches); write the constant exactly once in that form, as code;
(b) an added `refs/pull/<n>/head` (GitHub-managed; a PR is the operator's act);
(c) the default branch moved by fast-forward (old sha is an ancestor of the
new one) where no commit in `old..new` is in the work branch's `base..tip`
(someone else's merge, not this run pushing to main).
Everything else FAILs as today, and the reason still names each ref. A
deleted ref is never accounted for. Tests in `tests/test_cloud_audit.py`:
one per case (a)(b)(c) → PASS with the ref listed as accounted; a `task/<id>`
ref with no prepared run → FAIL; main moved to include a work-branch commit
→ FAIL; a deleted ref → FAIL. `docs/cloud.md` (containment paragraph) and
`CHANGELOG.md` (Unreleased). Use portable test fixtures (no GNU-only
`sed -i`; 0076's portability test must stay green).
